title: ROBOTIS 2026 half-year consolidated income statement
excerpt: First-half revenue was KRW 27.213 billion; second-quarter operating profit was KRW 1.981 billion.
summary: The XBRL statement confirms 50.3% first-half revenue growth, a KRW 9.862 billion reported operating loss, and a profitable second quarter with a 12.9% operating margin.
